description: One card on a dashboard - what it counts, how it is broken down, and which records it covers.

fields.description: The short name dashboards use to point at this card, in lower case with underscores. It cannot be changed once saved.
fields.label: Chart Name

fields.description: The card's heading. Changing it moves the heading on every dashboard showing this card.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: A line under the heading saying what the number counts. Optional.
fields.label: Subtitle

fields.description: Unticked, the card is skipped everywhere, even where a dashboard still names it.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The kind of card, and the list it counts.
fields.label: What It Is

fields.description: Number is a single figure with no breakdown. Every other kind breaks the figure down, and needs either a Group By Field or a Time Bucket.
fields.label: Chart Type
fields.options:
number
donut
bar
line
stacked_bar
heatmap

fields.description: The list the card counts - leads or tasks.
fields.label: Source List

fields.description: The figure itself, and the column it is broken down by.
fields.label: What Is Measured

fields.description: Count counts records. Sum and Average work over a numeric column, named below. Distinct counts how many different values a column holds.
fields.label: Aggregate

fields.description: The column Sum or Average is taken over. Ignored by Count.
fields.label: Aggregate Field

fields.description: The column the card is broken down by, and the column a click filters on. Leave empty only when a Time Bucket supplies the axis instead.
fields.label: Group By Field

fields.description: A second column, turning one line into one per value - tasks a month, split by task type. A heatmap requires it.
fields.label: Split By

fields.description: The number of slices or bars shown, largest first. Ignored by a number card.
fields.label: Row Limit

fields.description: The records the card covers, and whether the dashboard's date range applies to it at all.
fields.label: Which Records Count

fields.description: The date column the dashboard's date range is applied to.
fields.label: Date Field

fields.description: Set to month, the card's axis becomes the month instead of a column, which is what makes a trend. Keep the date range inside one year.
fields.label: Time Bucket

fields.description: Ticked, the card answers for the dashboard's date range. Unticked, it always shows the position right now - which is what a card like Overdue Tasks means.
fields.label: Honours Date Range

fields.description: The records this card is about, before anyone touches a filter. It can only narrow the card, never widen it.
fields.label: Base Filters (JSON)

fields.description: Ticked, the card can be clicked to open the list of records behind the figure.
fields.label: Drill Enabled

name: CRM Dashboard Chart
